units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:5">Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ</cite> top <he>בפ׳ האחרונה נתכפרו וכ׳</he> with the last piece blown off the altar the owner obtains forgiveness (as if it had been burnt).

senses.gloss: eruption, esp. the white eruption which causes the leper to be declared clean (Lev. XIII, 12, v. פָּרַח).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:4">Neg. VIII, 4</cite> [read:] <he>כל פְּרִיחוֹת ראשי איברים שבפְרִיחָתָן טהרו טמא כשחזרו וכ׳</he> as regards the eruptions on the main limbs, on the ground of which they declared the unclean clean, whenever they resume their natural color, he is unclean again.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>מעכב את הפ׳</he> prevents the person from being declared clean on account of the white eruption.

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 3:9">Tosef. ib. III, 9</cite> <he>פְּרִיחַת היחלט</he> (not <cite ref="Q01801"><he>פריחה</he></cite>) the eruption which appears after the person has been declared definitely unclean; <he>פריחת הסגר</he> after he has been locked up for probation; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּרִיחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:4">Neg. VIII, 4</cite>, v. supra; a. e.
